_comment: ONE menu control layout for every cabinet (standup, sit-down, racing rig, flight rig, pedestal). tools/Set-MenuControls.ps1 writes it into each frontend's controls.conf. Buttons are by POSITION, the order the Xbox pad, the CoinOPS wiring table and the G29 share: 0 = A / panel button 1 / wheel Cross, 1 = B / button 2, 2 = X / button 3, 3 = Y / button 4, 4 = LB / button 5 / right paddle, 5 = RB / button 6 / left paddle, 6 = Back / Select, 7 = Start. 'keys' are SDL key names: a keyboard, plus the I-PAC default panel keys (P1 buttons Left Ctrl, Left Alt, Space, Left Shift, Z, X; Start 1; Coin 5). Tokens a cabinet has on top of these (pedal axes, touch gestures, mouse) are kept. joyNoPedals: added only on cabinets without pedals - pedals are joystick axes and one can rest at the end of its travel, so on a racing rig stick-down is left as that cabinet has it (RACE1's original build has it and works).

quit.does: Close the frontend (keyboard only, so players can't leave the cabinet)
